title: [Feature Request]: Add support for new gemini models
body:
### Feature Description

Add support for new gemini models in llama_index integrations

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/525f93ea-2603-4d84-a1a3-d7920f50d186)

List found at https://aistudio.google.com/


### Reason

More models help developers have a wider variety of choices.

### Value of Feature

More model choice
